clue.text: In favour of those who are healthy receiving a financial reward

parts.note: pro means in favour of, as in pros and cons
the fit are those in good health

explanation.surface: A bonus paid to people who stay in good health.
explanation.definitionFit: Gain made on a deal is money earned over and above costs.

clue.text: Request to provide music that's nice

parts.note: a plea is an earnest request
to sing is to make music with the voice

explanation.surface: Asking someone to play a tune that's pleasant.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe something agreeable that gives enjoyment.

clue.text: Rents launches

definitions.meaning: rents here are tears or gaps, holes in fabric
launches as in the first nights or debuts of shows

explanation.definitionFit: Gaps or tears in cloth, and premieres or starts of ventures, both carry this plural noun.

clue.text: Complete agreement that one with depression should take it at end of the day

parts.note: the Roman numeral for one is I
a dent is a small hollow or depression

indicators.note: the end of the word day is its final letter only

explanation.surface: Advice that a depressed person should take things easy as evening comes.
explanation.definitionFit: Exact sameness, as in identity of views, means total correspondence.

clue.text: Gave up and went to bed

definitions.meaning: to turn in a suspect or a weapon is to hand it over
to turn in is an idiom for retiring for the night

explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both surrendered something to authority and retired for the night.

clue.text: International organisation had second sight later on article on first lady which was one-sided

parts.note: UN is the United Nations

indicators.note: the second letter of the word sight is taken alone

parts.note: taken as written
a is the indefinite article

indicators.note: the first letter of the word lady is picked out

explanation.surface: A UN body hearing about a woman with clairvoyance and a one-sided decision.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Second sight' looks like clairvoyance, but it asks for the second letter of 'sight'. The word 'on' just strings pieces together and 'which was' links to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Action taken by one party alone, without others agreeing, is partial or lopsided.

clue.text: Fancy something might be returned in time

indicators.note: in places the turned word inside the time of day

parts.note: noon is a time of day, midday

indicators.note: returned asks for the word for something to be read backwards

parts.note: it is an indefinite something

explanation.surface: Wondering whether something would come back in time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'might be returned' turns IT into TI, and 'in' puts TI inside NOON.
explanation.definitionFit: A fancy is an idea or whim, a passing thought.

clue.text: Lives after being killed by double dagger

indicators.note: after puts the word for lives behind the word for dying

parts.note: dies means loses life, as in being killed
is means exists or lives

explanation.surface: Someone survives being stabbed twice.
explanation.walkthrough: The diesis is a printer's mark, the double dagger used for a second footnote.
explanation.definitionFit: The printers' reference mark ‡ goes by this name in typography.

clue.text: Wanted to live around this way, so made a home

definitions.text: Wanted to live around this way, so made a home

parts.words: Wanted to live around this way, so made a home
parts.note: a bird that wanted to settle locally built its home of twigs, settling cosily in place

explanation.surface: Someone liked the area so much they settled down there.
explanation.definitionFit: Birds build a nest to settle in, so having done so they made a home.

clue.text: Team who show one by one

definitions.meaning: a cricket or football side has this many players
the number written in digits is a one beside a one

explanation.definitionFit: A football side numbers this many, and the figure 11 shows two ones side by side.

clue.text: Girl's hair can cause great unhappiness

parts.note: Di, short for Diana, is a girl's name; possessive adds S
a tress is a lock of hair

explanation.surface: A young woman's hairdo upsets her greatly.
explanation.definitionFit: Anguish or acute sorrow is severe misery.

clue.text: Goes around in women's clothes

definitions.meaning: to skirt a place is to pass round its edge

explanation.definitionFit: Circles the edge of something, and dresses hanging from the waist, share this word.

clue.text: River which is no distance from aromatic creeping plant

parts.note: the Cam is the river through Cambridge
O is zero, nothing
a mile is a distance

explanation.surface: A fragrant plant growing close by the river.
explanation.definitionFit: Chamomile is a scented herb that spreads along the ground, used for tea.

clue.text: Made to include square in disguise

indicators.note: the word made is split open to take the other letters

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: in here signals the word square appearing rearranged inside

explanation.surface: Something forced to be conventional while in costume.
explanation.walkthrough: SQUERA, a rearrangement of 'square', goes inside MADE; the whole thing is equally an anagram of 'made square'.
explanation.definitionFit: A masquerade is a pretence or false show, a mask over the truth.

clue.text: The right names for bad dreams!

indicators.note: bad suggests the letters of right names are spoiled and rearranged

explanation.surface: Appropriate titles for frightening dreams.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bad' pulls double weight in the surface as part of 'bad dreams', but it is the anagram signal; the definition is the dreams.
explanation.definitionFit: Frightening visions in sleep are a kind of dream.

clue.text: Bent over backwards to find wire in long grass

indicators.note: in puts the cable inside the grass

parts.note: reed is tall grass of wetlands
flex is electrical cable or wire

explanation.surface: Contorting oneself to find a cable lost in tall grass.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition looks like the idiom for trying very hard, but in botany 'reflexed' literally means bent back.
explanation.definitionFit: Petals or leaves turned back on themselves are described this way in botany.

clue.text: Left artist with something to produce his picture

parts.note: port is the left side of a ship
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
it is an indefinite something

explanation.surface: An artist who has just departed paints his own likeness.
explanation.definitionFit: A painting or photograph of a person is a likeness or image.

clue.text: Surprised when beginning actually came first!

parts.note: a start is a beginning
led means went in front, came first

explanation.surface: Amazed that the opening was really the winner.
explanation.definitionFit: Jumping in alarm is being taken aback or shocked.

clue.text: Conventional base for a unit of measurement

parts.note: square is slang for old-fashioned or conventional
the foot of something is its base

explanation.surface: A traditional starting point for measuring things.
explanation.definitionFit: An area one foot on each side is a standard imperial measure.

clue.text: Drug supplier turns up with lady holding sore head

indicators.note: turns means the word up is read backwards

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the head of sore is its first letter

parts.note: her refers to a woman

explanation.surface: A dealer shows up with a woman nursing a headache.
explanation.definitionFit: A pusher is slang for someone who sells illegal narcotics.

clue.text: Fruit for mother's boy?

parts.note: a dam is an animal mother
a son is a boy

explanation.surface: A fruit for a child who clings to his mother.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mother's boy' reads as a doting son, but here DAM (an animal's mother, as for horses) is followed by SON.
explanation.definitionFit: A damson is a small dark purple plum.

clue.text: Even dim sun will encourage some to remove their clothes!

definitions.text: Even dim sun will encourage some to remove their clothes!

indicators.note: the letters of dim sun are coaxed into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Even weak sunshine tempts some people to strip off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'will encourage' is a loose anagram signal working on 'dim sun'; the whole clue describes the habit.
explanation.definitionFit: Naturism is the practice of going about unclothed.

clue.text: Not happy like Victoria was

definitions.meaning: Queen Victoria is said to have declared 'We are not amused'

explanation.definitionFit: Displeased, and the state famously claimed by Queen Victoria in her alleged remark.

clue.text: A kind of overcoat worn in Ireland

definitions.meaning: A province in the north of the island of Ireland

explanation.definitionFit: A long heavy topcoat named after the northern Irish province, which also carries the name.

clue.text: I shot pal by mistake: he was taken here

indicators.note: mistake suggests the letters of I shot pal are jumbled

explanation.surface: A hunting accident: the shooter's friend was rushed to the infirmary.
explanation.definitionFit: An injured man is carried to a medical centre for treatment.

clue.text: End of an animal: in the soup!

definitions.text: End of an animal: in the soup!

parts.words: End of an animal: in the soup!
parts.note: a beast's rear appendage that ends up as a broth ingredient, with 'in the soup' also meaning in trouble

explanation.surface: An animal comes to a sticky end in the cooking pot.
explanation.definitionFit: The rear appendage of cattle is used in a classic thick soup.

clue.text: Recount one perhaps about an anaesthetist

parts.note: re means about or concerning
jokingly, one who numbs a patient

explanation.surface: Telling the story of a single anaesthetist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one perhaps' hints that a number is what is counted again; the anaesthetist is read as 'numb-er', one who numbs.
explanation.definitionFit: To count or assign figures again is to re-tally.

clue.text: Chap who took some sort of diet and cut things out

parts.note: Ed is a man's name

indicators.note: some sort of means the word diet is rearranged into a variant

explanation.surface: A man on a strange diet dropped certain foods.
explanation.definitionFit: Revising text means removing parts and correcting it.
